rules.split: sha256(source_id) sorted; every third is heldout, before fitting
rules.covariance: formal centroid + independent frame translation covariance; Gaia differential covariance for real controls; no heldout recalibration
rules.injection_psf: same official nearest-zone ePSF as fitter; no extra noise or shot noise added

positive_control.selection: highest Gaia proper motion, before any image fit
positive_control.propagation: Astropy space motion with perspective acceleration, first-order observer parallax; RV uncertainty omitted

rules.scope: three new sky fields; QR2 only; known-position local fitting; not blind detection or full uncertainty calibration
